notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Eastern US Lookouts page gives only the name and Santa Rosa County. Two web searches found nothing about the tower itself. The Mapcarta page is derived from OpenStreetMap (node 358693856, tagged man_made=tower), so it shows the tower is mapped, not that it stands; its 203 ft elevation is ground level and was not used as a height. Coldwater does not appear in the cached NHLR Florida list (31 entries) or the cached FFLOS and Forest Fire Lookout Association Florida pages. A search snippet mentioned a Coldwater Creek recreation area inside Blackwater River State Forest; it was not read and no source ties it to the lookout. The story is about 75 words, under the 120-word floor. Recommend leaving the record at status unknown until a Florida Forest Service or Santa Rosa County source is found.
